current_news.title: Interim committees finish bill drafts before the 2027 General Session
current_news.summary: Three legislative panels meet in Cheyenne this week to finish interim bill drafts ahead of the 2027 General Session, which convenes Jan. 12. The Joint Education Committee meets Nov. 17, and the Select Committee on Blockchain, Financial Technology and Digital Innovation Technology meets Nov. 19-20. Management Council meets Nov. 23 to consider the session calendar.

special.title: Certified election results set the calendar for the 2027 Legislature
special.summary: The State Canvassing Board certified the Nov. 3 general election results on Nov. 10. Statewide and legislative officers elected this year assume office on Jan. 4, 2027. The 69th Legislature convenes its 2027 General Session on Jan. 12.
